## Problem and scope

What user job or documented discrepancy does this change address? What is excluded?

## Change

Explain the smallest coherent change and any profile/schema/compatibility impact.

## Verification

Name the exact candidate, actual checks and outcomes, first failures, and checks not run. For a fix, show the relevant old-fails/new-passes regression and a valid control. Documentation-only changes do not need invented runtime tests.

## Boundaries

Account for private data, input/output safety, dependency/license provenance and material AI assistance. This PR does not by itself authorize merge, release, deployment or processing customer files.
